subject: s0688

geometry_source.dataset: TotalSegmentator dataset v2.0.1 (Wasserthal J. et al.)
geometry_source.access: HTTP range extraction of mask members from the 23.5 GB Zenodo zip; the CT image volume was NEVER downloaded and nothing in this project is derived from CT greyscale

length_verdict: MEASURED 30.55 cm vs published 18-26 cm -> ABOVE the published range by 17.5%. Reported as computed; no parameter was adjusted. The label spans C6 to T12 (cricopharyngeal region to the gastro-oesophageal junction, 1.50 mm minimum surface gap to the stomach label), so it is not obviously over-extended at either end. Candidate contributors, none of which this project can separate: in-vivo supine CT length exceeds cadaveric and endoscopic estimates; this subject's GOJ label sits at T12, lower than the usual T10-T11; and a centreline through a curved tube is longer than a cranio-caudal measurement (measured tortuosity 1.043).

wall_layers.name: mucosa
wall_layers.sub: non-keratinised stratified squamous epithelium + lamina propria + muscularis mucosae
wall_layers.zh_sub: 复层鳞状上皮 + 固有层 + 黏膜肌层
wall_layers.ref: EUS layer 1-2; squamous epithelium 300-500 um, Gray's 41e
wall_layers.note: stratified SQUAMOUS — the stomach, small intestine and colon are simple COLUMNAR. The squamocolumnar junction (Z-line) at the GOJ is the abrupt transition.

wall_layers.name: submucosa
wall_layers.sub: areolar tissue, oesophageal glands proper, submucosal venous plexus, Meissner plexus
wall_layers.zh_sub: 疏松结缔组织、食管固有腺、黏膜下静脉丛、黏膜下神经丛
wall_layers.note: the oesophageal glands proper are submucosal and secrete mucus + bicarbonate

wall_layers.name: muscularis_propria
wall_layers.zh_sub: 内环行肌 + 外纵行肌
wall_layers.ref: EUS layer 4; total wall 3-6 mm on CT
wall_layers.note: muscle TYPE changes along the long axis — see muscle_transition

wall_layers.name: adventitia
wall_layers.sub: loose areolar connective tissue, NO mesothelium
wall_layers.note: ADVENTITIA, not serosa. The cervical and thoracic oesophagus has no serosal covering, so there is no mesothelial barrier to tumour spread and no serosa to hold sutures — the anatomical reason oesophageal anastomoses leak more than gastric or colonic ones. Only the short intra-abdominal segment has a peritoneal (serosal) covering on its anterior aspect.

wall_note: layer thicknesses are PUBLISHED values (endoscopic ultrasound layer correlates and histology), not measured from this subject. A 1.5 mm isotropic CT label cannot resolve a 0.5 mm mucosa. The organ surface and the inscribed-radius profile are measured; everything inside the wall is published anatomy.

segments.name: upper_third
segments.innervation: somatic, nucleus ambiguus via the vagus; voluntary onset of swallowing
segments.zh_innervation: 躯体神经 — 疑核经迷走神经；吞咽起始受随意控制
segments.peristalsis_mechanism: sequential central activation of motor neurons (central programme)

segments.name: middle_third
segments.innervation: transition zone, both somatic and autonomic
segments.zh_innervation: 过渡区，躯体与自主神经并存
segments.peristalsis_mechanism: overlap of central programme and myenteric (intrinsic) control

segments.name: lower_third
segments.innervation: autonomic, dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus + myenteric plexus
segments.zh_innervation: 自主神经 — 迷走神经背核 + 肌间神经丛
segments.peristalsis_mechanism: intrinsic myenteric circuitry; survives vagotomy, abolished by myenteric loss (achalasia)

muscle_transition.basis: classic thirds (Gray's Anatomy 41e). Published refinement: striated muscle alone occupies only the proximal ~5%, the transition zone spans roughly 35-40% of the length, and the distal ~50-60% is smooth muscle only. The thirds are a TEACHING SIMPLIFICATION, not a measurement, and are not contour-anchored to this subject.

sphincters.name: upper_oesophageal_sphincter
sphincters.muscle: cricopharyngeus (+ inferior pharyngeal constrictor, proximal oesophagus)
sphincters.ref: high-resolution manometry, resting UES pressure is highly variable and markedly asymmetric (antero-posterior >> lateral); ranges of 30-120 mmHg are reported
sphincters.level: C6 classically; this subject's radius minimum is at C7
sphincters.note: tonically closed by continuous motor discharge; relaxes 0.2-0.5 s before the bolus

sphincters.name: lower_oesophageal_sphincter
sphincters.muscle: intrinsic smooth-muscle thickening + extrinsic crural diaphragm
sphincters.ref: high-resolution manometry, resting LES pressure 10-30 mmHg above gastric
sphincters.level: T10-T11 classically (diaphragmatic hiatus); not resolvable in this subject
sphincters.note: deglutitive relaxation lasts the whole peristaltic transit; TRANSIENT LES RELAXATION (tLESR) is vagally mediated, independent of swallowing, and is the dominant mechanism of physiological and pathological gastro-oesophageal reflux

primary.speed_reference: primary peristaltic wave 2-4 cm/s (Gray's Anatomy 41e; Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology 26e ch.25)
primary.transit_reference: UES-to-LES transit of a single swallow, 6-10 s, high-resolution manometry
primary.speed_selection: the declared speed is the midpoint of the INTERSECTION of the published wave-speed range (20-40 mm/s) with the range implied by this subject's measured length (305.5 mm) and the published 6-10 s transit window; both derived quantities therefore sit inside their own published ranges by construction, which is stated here rather than presented as an independent validation.
primary.depth_note: DECLARED VISUALISATION VALUE. A real primary wave occludes the lumen completely; a 1.0 occlusion would collapse the rendered tube to a line, so 0.55 of the local inscribed radius is used.

secondary.trigger: local distension by a retained bolus or refluxate; no pharyngeal phase
secondary.onset_site: the distended segment, propagating aborally only
secondary.reference: secondary peristalsis is elicited by oesophageal distension and clears residue; it is intact after pharyngeal anaesthesia

transition_zone.basis: the pressure trough / propagation slowing at the striated-to-smooth muscle transition is a reproducible HRM finding; the 0.75 factor is a DECLARED value, not a measurement

peristalsis.segmental_mechanism: the striated upper third is driven by sequential central motor activation and the smooth lower third by intrinsic myenteric circuitry — the wave looks continuous but is generated by two different mechanisms, which is why a vagotomy abolishes the proximal wave and achalasia the distal one

les_tlesr_demo.kind: phenomenological switch, NOT a mechanistic model

tlesr.reference: transient LES relaxations, 10-45 s, vagally mediated, triggered by gastric fundic distension; the dominant mechanism of both physiological and pathological gastro-oesophageal reflux

les_tlesr_demo.declaration: the reflux animation shows a retrograde gastric-content front entering the distal oesophagus during a tLESR. There is no pressure solver behind it: the front position is a prescribed function of time. No pH, no volume and no clearance kinetics are modelled.

pharmacology.statement: THE OESOPHAGUS IS NOT A DRUG ABSORPTION SITE. Normal transit of a swallowed dose is a few seconds, the epithelium is stratified squamous and keratin-poor but multilayered, and the surface area is of the order of 0.02 m2 against ~200 m2 for the small intestine. No clinically meaningful fraction of an oral dose is absorbed here. This page makes no ADME flux claim for the oesophagus.

what_matters_here.detail: the stratified squamous epithelium plus the tight-junction-bearing superficial layers and the submucosal glands' mucus/bicarbonate secretion are the pre-epithelial and epithelial defence against refluxed acid and pepsin. Dilated intercellular spaces are the earliest histological lesion in reflux disease.

the oesophageal glands proper (submucosal, mucous) and the superficial cardiac glands secrete mucus and HCO3-; secretion is vagally stimulated and is the basis of the post-prandial clearance of residual acid.

this is the oesophagus's real pharmacological significance. A tablet or capsule that lodges in the oesophagus releases a high local concentration against a squamous epithelium with no mucus blanket. Classic culprits: doxycycline and other tetracyclines (direct acid injury, pH of a dissolving doxycycline capsule ~3), potassium chloride (hyperosmolar necrosis), bisphosphonates (alendronate, direct caustic injury), NSAIDs, quinidine, ferrous sulphate, ascorbic acid. Retention is most common at the measured narrowings and behind the left atrium - exactly the levels this page measures. Prophylaxis is mechanical, not pharmacological: 100-200 mL of water and remaining upright for 30 min.
what_matters_here.retention_sites: the measured constrictions at C7, T4 and T6, and the retrocardiac T8 minimum

what_matters_here.detail: swallowed topical corticosteroid (budesonide/fluticasone) for eosinophilic oesophagitis is one of the very few deliberately oesophageal drug targets, and it works by surface contact, not absorption.

pharmacology.probe_drug_panel_note: the four probe drugs used elsewhere in this project (midazolam/CYP3A4, dextromethorphan/CYP2D6, metformin/OCT2-MATE, fexofenadine/P-gp-OATP) have NO oesophageal ADME step. They appear on this page only as transit, not as metabolism or transport.

cross_organ_links.liver: the porto-systemic anastomosis in the distal oesophageal submucosa (left gastric vein, portal <-> azygos, systemic) is the shared boundary with the liver page: portal hypertension on that page is what reverses flow in V3 here and dilates the palisade-zone channels into varices.
cross_organ_links.stomach: the oesophagus terminates at the measured gastro-oesophageal junction, 1.50 mm minimum surface gap from this subject's stomach label; the squamocolumnar (Z-line) transition is at that boundary.
cross_organ_links.small_intestine: continuity is through the stomach; there is no direct oesophago-enteric boundary.
cross_organ_links.heart: the arterial pulsatility on this page is driven by the aortic flow waveform computed by this project's heart model (CO 5.1771 L/min, MAP 94.4872 mmHg, HR 64.45 bpm), not by a new waveform.

honesty.upstream_physiological_data: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database record 16265 — PUBLIC PLACEHOLDER carried in from the heart page. NOT the user's own data.
honesty.no_calibration_coefficients: no expression-to-flux, abundance-to-conductance or any other calibration coefficient is used anywhere on this page. Molecular-layer values are shown as measured expression only; the mapping onto the wall diagram is qualitative (which cell type, which membrane face).
